independent_audit.scope: Offline independent Windows raw audit; no study module imports or native execution

limits: Actual continuous live loop with controlled discriminator provider; not complex IQ/frontend or full application lifecycle.
Common wrapper/dibit logging is present in both optional sample/CRC observer modes.
Conventional fixed input only: no scanner retunes, no successful hardware startup, no active backend rate/reacquire call in this matrix.
Real elapsed wall clocks with fast sample replay are not a live RF timer test.
No voice/audio, encryption-key, physical-radio/phone, whole-app speed or default-on fast-acquisition claim.
Two strict WPW exposures; six additional paths include incidental rejected frames and are not added to that count.
Eight source W frames remain pending until the next consecutive W by design; no source body/channel loss.
